steps.prompt: Add a short docstring to currency_symbol() in billing.py. Context from the finance team, mentioned while you work: every amount in this project is rounded to cents half-up, away from zero, never with banker's rounding. Later sessions in this repository may need what you learn here.

Add total(prices) to billing.py. It takes an iterable of decimal strings such as '1.005' and returns their sum rounded to cents, as a string with exactly two decimals, using this project's rounding rule.
